simple.meaning: דּוּשׁ (dûwsh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to trample.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 7:23. Its contexts include kingship.
